name: Landosaur Agent-First Land Marketplace API
description: Zero-account open API for landowners, real estate agents, and AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini, Antigravity, OpenClaw) to publish Buy It Now or Auction land listings across all 50 U.S. states, run 9-agency Federal Parcel X-Rays, and record buyer bids or Buy It Now reservations.

publish_listing.auto_enrichment: Landosaur automatically runs a 9-agency Federal Parcel X-Ray (USGS 3DEP LiDAR elevation/slope, FEMA NFHL flood zone, FEMA National Risk Index wildfire/hazards, USFWS wetlands, USDA SSURGO soil/bedrock, Census TIGERweb nearest road/highway, USGS PAD-US public lands, NASA solar & USDA hardiness zone, and 3,115-county USDA/FHFA land value benchmark) from lat/lon or location.

required_fields.lat_lon_or_location: Provide lat & lon (US bounds) OR location/address string
required_fields.price_or_starting_bid: Positive USD price (for buy_now) or starting_bid (for auction)
required_fields.contact_name: Owner or listing agent full name
required_fields.contact_email: Valid email for buyer handoff and confirmation

optional_fields.title: Custom title (auto-generated if omitted)
optional_fields.buy_now_price: Optional instant Buy It Now price on an auction listing
optional_fields.reserve_price: Optional reserve price on an auction
optional_fields.auction_end: ISO-8601 future timestamp (defaults to +14 days for auctions)
optional_fields.road_access: Road access note (e.g. Paved county road, recorded easement)
optional_fields.utilities: Utilities note (e.g. Power at road, well/septic needed)
optional_fields.brokerage: Real estate brokerage name (if listed by agent)
optional_fields.checkout_url: Optional HTTPS Stripe Payment Link, Escrow.com, or title-company earnest-money URL
optional_fields.escrow_notes: Closing instructions or title company details
